caption:
Failed yesterday's knee-to-wall test? Start here. 👇

1️⃣ Seated ankle circles: heel down, 10 slow circles each way, each ankle
2️⃣ Foam roll calves: 60 seconds per side, pause on tight spots
3️⃣ Calf raise + pause: 2 x 12, big-toe pressure, 2-second hold at the top

✅ Daily for 2 weeks, then retest
❌ Don't bounce or push through pain

Save this so you can find it tonight.
